custom.copy: Real customers wearing AXUM — including one-of-one custom pieces: spikes, hand-painting, custom dye. DM us your photo to join the feed.
editorial.manifesto_text: The corset is our signature. Every shade, dyed by hand.
editorial.studio_text: AXUM is a Bali-based label. We began with corsets — they became the face of the brand — and grew into skirts, jeans and beyond. Every colour is custom-dyed by hand in our own technique, cut in small batches from 100% cotton.
newsletter.copy: Four times a year, we send a single image and a sentence. Nothing else. No promotions, no noise. Worth opening.
